contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, cafe and florist shopfronts, canvas awnings, utility pipes and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The bicycle and combination lock are scene props, not products. Bent forward over the lock: the black short zip jacket back and hem, the gray tee below the neckline and the cream cropped trousers' waist are conservatively reconstructed. The silver round white-dial watch on a linked metal bracelet is visible on the wrist. Black socks show above the black derbies. Only one silver ball stud is visible; the pair is inferred. Brand, metal, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

copy.titleEn: A BRIEF STRUGGLE WITH THE BICYCLE LOCK

title.en: A brief struggle with the bicycle lock
title.de: Ein kurzer Kampf mit dem Fahrradschloss

deck.ko: 검정 지퍼 재킷과 크림 크롭 팬츠의 명확한 대비.
deck.en: Black zip jacket contrasts clearly with cream cropped trousers.
deck.de: Schwarze Zipjacke steht klar gegen verkürztes Creme.

intro.ko: 잠금이 잘 풀리지 않아 무릎을 조금 굽히고 손목을 가까이 모읍니다.
intro.en: A stubborn lock brings the wrists together and bends the knees slightly.
intro.de: Das widerspenstige Schloss führt die Handgelenke zusammen und beugt die Knie etwas.

body.ko: 검정 재킷 아래 회색 티가 목선의 어둠을 나눕니다. 크림 바지는 여유 있는 직선으로 떨어지고 검정 양말과 더비가 발끝을 묶습니다. 소매를 올리자 흰 다이얼의 은색 링크 시계가 보이고 작은 은색 스터드가 헤어 옆을 마무리합니다. 직광 플래시는 숙인 몸의 자연스러운 주름과 자물쇠를 잡는 손을 또렷하게 남깁니다.
body.en: A gray tee divides the dark neckline inside the black jacket. Cream trousers fall in a relaxed straight line, finished with black socks and derbies. Raised sleeves reveal a silver linked watch with a white dial, while tiny silver studs finish the tied-back hair. Direct flash records natural body folds and hands working on the lock.
body.de: Ein graues Shirt unterteilt den dunklen Ausschnitt in der schwarzen Jacke. Die cremefarbene Hose fällt locker und gerade zu schwarzen Socken und Derbys. Hochgeschobene Ärmel zeigen eine silberne Gliederuhr mit weißem Zifferblatt, winzige Silberstecker ergänzen das gebundene Haar. Direkter Blitz hält natürliche Falten und die Hände am Schloss fest.

tip.ko: 자물쇠를 풀 때 커프를 올리고 신발 끈 끝을 짧게 정리해 두세요.
tip.en: Raise the cuffs while unlocking and keep the shoe lace ends short.
tip.de: Beim Aufschließen die Bündchen hochschieben und die Schnürsenkelenden kurz halten.

description.ko: 작은 칼라와 긴소매, 곧은 밑단, 측면 포켓의 검정 재킷입니다.
description.en: Black jacket with small collar, long sleeves, straight hem and side pockets.
description.de: Schwarze Jacke mit kleinem Kragen, langen Ärmeln, geradem Saum und Seitentaschen.

howToWear.ko: 자물쇠를 풀 때 커프를 잠시 올려 손목과 손을 비우세요.
howToWear.en: Push the cuffs up briefly to free wrists and hands while unlocking.
howToWear.de: Beim Aufschließen die Bündchen kurz hochschieben und Hände sowie Handgelenke frei halten.
